title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
description:
Job description

Team & Reporting Line: Program Management Team | Reports to Lead Project & Procurement Manager

Our Mission 

At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth – where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions.

From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world.

Your Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-driven team player to join our Product and Quality Assurance (PQA) team, with a strong focus on Flight Software Product Assurance.

In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of both flight and ground software across our growing satellite constellation. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality, and operations, helping to shape how we build and deliver software in a fast-moving, mission-critical space environment.

The PQA team defines and maintains the company’s quality and Product Assurance standards. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring our software meets the highest levels of robustness, compliance, and reliability, supporting mission success in both orbit and ground operations.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complex, technical environments, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable balancing structured quality processes with the pace of a rapidly scaling space organisation. You will be trusted to take end-to-end ownership, bring clarity to ambiguity, and help embed strong engineering discipline across the software lifecycle.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust Software Product Assurance (PA) programme, reporting directly to the Product Assurance Manager.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of Software Product Assurance across both flight and ground software for our satellite constellation.

  • Ensure rigorous application of software configuration management and release processes, maintaining strong version control, traceability, and engineering discipline.

  • Enforce compliance with safety-critical and mission-critical software standards, with a strong focus on risk reduction and failure prevention.

  • Define and oversee software testing, verification, and validation strategies across all development and delivery phases.

  • Investigate, manage, and resolve software anomalies throughout development, testing, integration, and operational phases.

  • Support Spacecraft Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) activities, ensuring software readiness and compliance at every stage.

  • Coordinate and lead software deliveries from suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal standards, schedules, and quality expectations.

  • Participate in subcontractor reviews and key technical meetings, working closely with procurement engineers and Product Assurance stakeholders.

  • Balance the demands of rapid development cycles with the need to maintain strong Product Assurance and software quality standards in a fast-paced space environment.

Job requirements

About you 

Required: 

  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

  • Proven experience in Flight Software Product Assurance within the space industry.

  • Strong understanding of software testing, verification, and validation in safety-critical environments.

  • Experience with embedded flight software for satellites, spacecraft platforms, or payload systems (experience with FDIR highly desirable).

  • Strong proficiency in software configuration management tools and processes.

  • Familiarity with ECSS standards, particularly ECSS-Q-ST-80C (Software Product Assurance) and ECSS-E-ST-40C (Software Engineering).

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with experience in risk management and anomaly investigation.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines, with a proactive approach to risk identification and escalation.

  • Strong team mindset, with a desire to help build and shape a growing organisation.

  • Comfortable working independently, taking ownership and delivering in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Nice to Have: 

  • Experience with automation, scripting, or AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. prompt-based workflows).

  • Exposure to high-growth or start-up aerospace environments.

  • Broader understanding of end-to-end spacecraft systems engineering lifecycles.

Why join constellr?

  • High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies.
  • Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match.
  • Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers.
  • Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy.
  • Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.

description: Company Description Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. Job Description The Software Engineer (.NET/Azure) is a hands-on, mid-level contributor responsible for designing, building, and modernizing high-volume, high-transaction applications across the Experian Employer Services (EES) organization. You will write production code, participate in code reviews, evaluate SAST findings, and work closely with product, quality engineering, security, and operations partners to deliver secure, reliable software to our clients and partners. AI and automation are the main focus of our team. EES is adopting an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) and spec-driven agentic development, in which teams define intent, constraints, acceptance criteria, and validation before AI agents build approved work. As an engineer in this model you will work from versioned specifications, direct AI coding agents to implement approved work, and oversee the review, testing, and security validation of what they produce. You will have already worked this way hands-on; this is a requirement of the role, not a learning goal. Humans remain accountable for technical decisions, data protection, and production outcomes. At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. This hybrid role reports to the Engineering Manager, Application Engineering, and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs: Costa Mesa, CA; San Jose, CA; Allen, TX; Austin, TX; Franklin, TN; New York, NY; Schaumberg, IL; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Seattle, WA Responsibilities: Analyze new feature requirements with attention to design, software development best practices, testing strategy, database design, security, and cloud architecture, and turn them into clear, versioned specifications with explicit acceptance criteria that engineers and AI agents can verify. Use AI coding assistants and agents (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to implement approved work, and own the review, testing, and security validation of AI-generated code before it is merged. Decide when a change needs additional human review based on its risk. Build new and modernize existing .NET applications, APIs, and partner integrations, including responsive, accessible web UIs that work across devices. Write high-quality, well-tested code: unit tests, integration tests, and contract tests, with observability built in. Automate repetitive engineering and operational work (pipelines, environment setup, test data, deployments) rather than performing it by hand. Maintain the team's reusable agent instructions, skills, and coding standards for the codebase, and help teammates use agentic tools well. Participate in code reviews and provide meaningful feedback on human-written and AI-generated code alike. Follow Experian's Secure SDLC. Evaluate and resolve SAST findings, handle sensitive and personal data safely, and never expose such data to AI tools or non-production environments without approved controls. Resolve defects identified by quality engineering and demonstrate completed functionality to the Product team for approval. Promote a DevOps culture, work with IT and operations, and participate in the on-call rotation for platform emergencies. Work within Agile and Scrum delivery while adapting planning and reporting as specifications and system-generated evidence replace ceremony-driven tracking. Qualifications Hands-on experience with spec-driven agentic development (mandatory). At least one year of personally using AI coding assistants or agents on production code: working from specifications, constraining the agent's scope, testing and reviewing its output, and deciding what requires human approval. Experience working within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) or a comparable spec-driven model with explicit specifications, automated validation, and human oversight. 6+ years of professional .NET development experience with C#, .NET 8+ (and .NET Framework for maintenance of existing systems), and ASP.NET Core. 2+ years building and operating solutions on Azure, including services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure Monitor. Experience with MS SQL Server, T-SQL, relational database design, and Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM. Experience designing, building, and integrating REST APIs and partner integrations, including authentication, versioning, and error handling. Solid front-end experience with HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and one modern SPA framework (Angular or React). Experience with service oriented or microservice architecture, messaging, and common cloud-native patterns. Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, Git branching workflows, and automated testing in the pipeline. Working knowledge of secure coding practices, SAST remediation, and handling of sensitive and personal data. Experience with Agile and Scrum delivery. Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience building GenAI-enabled features with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, or similar, including retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and output evaluation. Familiarity with Agent Skills or similar standards for reusable agent instructions and workflows. Experience with Playwright or similar end-to-end testing frameworks. Experience modernizing legacy .NET Framework applications and integrating acquired technologies into an existing product ecosystem. Azure certifications such as AZ-204 or AZ-400. General Requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 6+ years of professional .NET development experience 2+ years of Azure cloud experience 1+ year of hands-on spec-driven agentic development within AI DLC or a comparable model (mandatory) Additional Information Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours.
